newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Nationwide Financial Services.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Nationwide Financial Services.

text.p: Nationwide Insurance Enterprise, parent of Nationwide Life Insurance Co, said Monday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the initial public offering of Nationwide Financial Services Inc Class A common stock in the U.S. and internationally.
The proposed maximum aggregate offering price is $500 million, including an over-allotment option granted by Nationwide Financial Services, Nationwide said in a statement.
A member company of Nationwide Insurance Enterprise will own at least 80 percent of outstanding shares, it said.
Nationwide Financial Services also filed for a contemporaneous public offering of $300 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2027, the company said.

An affiliate, Nationwide Financial Services Capital Trust, also filed for a contemporaneous public offering of capital securities with an aggregate liquidation amount of $100 million, the proceeds of which will be lent to Nationwide Financial Services, Nationwide said.
It said underwriters are Credit Suisse First Boston, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co. Nationwide Insurance Enterprise said it has $65 billion in assets.
